```{r setup, include=FALSE}

# Load required packages
library(haven)     # for reading .dta files
library(readxl)    # for reading Excel files
install.packages("openxlsx")
library(openxlsx)
library(dplyr)     # for data manipulation
#install.packages("writexl")
library(writexl)
#install.packages ("tidyr")
library(tidyr)
#install.packages ("ggplot2")
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(survival)



```


##Load dataset about White and Black Participants
```{r cars}

ktr_white <- readRDS("R:/ARIC/Users/yl13544/02_EWAS_Tryptophan/01 Result/ratio_kt_W.rds")
ktr_black <- readRDS("R:/ARIC/Users/yl13544/02_EWAS_Tryptophan/01 Result/ratio_kt_B.rds")

View(ktr_white)
View(ktr_black)

# Rename columns to avoid conflicts
ktr_white <- ktr_white %>% rename (beta_white=beta, se_white = se)
ktr_black <- ktr_black %>% rename (beta_black=beta, se_black=se)

# Merge by CpG identifier
merged_ktr <- merge(ktr_white[, c("cpg", "beta_white","se_white")],
                    ktr_black[, c("cpg", "beta_black","se_black")],
                    by = "cpg")
merged_ktr <- merged_ktr %>% mutate(z_white = beta_white/se_white,
                                    z_black = beta_black/se_black)

View(merged_ktr)

cpg_list <- c(
  "cg07839457", "cg11699125", "cg16411857", "cg21979287", "cg16936953",
  "cg18942579", "cg01059398", "cg16306654", "cg09801824", "cg23387863",
  "cg03425812", "cg12828896", "cg00490406", "cg10636246", "cg03753191",
  "cg23904266", "cg12054453", "cg09249800", "cg08818207", "cg07878065",
  "cg02068052", "cg03957124", "cg27537252", "cg01409343", "cg13575798",
  "cg24741430", "cg04176813", "cg26140475", "cg14496081", "cg07830828"
)

subset_df <- merged_ktr[merged_ktr$cpg %in% cpg_list, ]

#View(subset_df)
range(merged_ktr$beta_white)
range(merged_ktr$beta_black)

```

## Including Plots of 30 CpGs


```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}

rep1 <- ggplot(subset_df, aes(x = beta_white, y = beta_black)) +
  geom_point(color = "darkred", size = 3) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-1, 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-1, 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "EWAS Effect Estimate (White participants)",
    y = "EWAS Effect Estimate (Black participants)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

rep1


ggsave(
  "R:/ARIC/Users/yl13544/02_EWAS_Tryptophan/01 Result/04 Plots/KTR_30cpt_plot.png",
  plot = rep1,
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 600
)

```

#### Calculate the pearson coefficient of the 30 cpgs 


```{r}


correlation <- cor(subset_df$beta_white, subset_df$beta_black, method = "pearson")
print(correlation)


```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
